This paper applies two of the registered criteria of rule~B, F1 and F2; under the registration the rule holds only if each of its criteria holds, so a failure of either gives ``not met''. The left column, the main analysis, applies the rules and thresholds of the plan and the registration to scores defined after the registered results were known (graphs of contracts, amounts in US dollars on five tokens, scores from the twelve months before each freeze, allowances counted up to the owner's balance), so none of its verdicts is a registered result; the right column is the test that the plan and the registration fixed.
